notes.subject: to ol man i no save yet na ol stupit man
notes.rationale: Wisdom addresses directly the simple and the fools.

notes.subject: הבינו
notes.rationale: Double imperative summons the hearers to understand.

notes.subject: ערמה
notes.rationale: Can mean trickery (bad) or discretion (good); here good sense, as the parallel with heart requires.

translation: Ol man i no save yet, harim gut: stretim tingting bilong yu long pasin bilong ol kleva man; na ol stupit man, harim gut: kisim bel bilong save.
